s=s.replace("assert review['component_forwards']==3288", "assert review['adopted_prior_returned_forwards']==268 and review['continuation_new_component_forwards']==3020\nadoption=read(root/'review-adoption-v2.json');assert adoption['adopted_head_calls']==268\noriginal_events=Path(adoption['original_forward_journal']['path']).read_bytes();original_observations=Path(adoption['original_observation_journal']['path']).read_bytes()\nassert review['component_forwards']==3288")

s=s.replace("'scientific_stage_failures':0,'full_training_restarts':0", "'scientific_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,'explicit_review_continuations':1,'repeated_review_calls':0,'adopted_original_review_calls':268,'continuation_review_calls':3020")

s=s.replace("print('PASS11 original owners terminal;", "print('PASS13 original/continuation owners terminal;268 adopted+3020 new review calls;")

s=(repo/'.cache/publish-v163-final-v1.py').read_text()
s=s.replace('v163-harmonic-phase-final-v1.json','v163-harmonic-phase-final-v2.json').replace("execution['recorded_owner_count']==11","execution['recorded_owner_count']==13")
s=s.replace("'postprocess-completion.json':'postprocess-status-v1.json'", "'postprocess-completion.json':'postprocess-status-v2.json'")
needle="sources['inherited-independent-mask-oracle.json']=Path(plan['previous'])/'training-mask-audit-v1.json'"
s=s.replace(needle,needle+'''
sources.update({name:root/path for name,path in {
    'original-postprocess-failure.json':'postprocess-status-v1.json','original-review-log.txt':'postprocess-review-v1.log',

    'publication-helper-preparation.json':'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json'}.items()})
adoption=read(root/'review-adoption-v2.json')
for name,key in [('original-review-forward-journal.jsonl','original_forward_journal'),
    ('original-review-observations.jsonl','original_observation_journal'),('original-review-export.pt','original_export')]:
    sources[name]=Path(adoption[key]['path'])
''')
s=s.replace('finish-v163-execution-v1.py','finish-v163-execution-v2.py').replace('build-v163-final-report-v1.py','build-v163-final-report-v2.py').replace('verify-v163-publication-v1.py','verify-v163-publication-v2.py')
s=s.replace('helpers=list(dict.fromkeys(helpers))', '''helpers += [repo/'.cache'/p for p in ['prepare-v163-review-continuation-v2.py','queue-v163-review-v2.py','launch-v163-review-v2.py','prepare-v163-final-revisions-v2.py']]

s=s.replace("'frozen_postprocess_hashes':read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['frozen_files']", "'original_frozen_postprocess_hashes':read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['frozen_files'],'continuation_frozen_postprocess_hashes':read(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json')['frozen_files']")
s=s.replace("'scientific_stage_failures':0,'full_training_restarts':0", "'scientific_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,'explicit_review_continuations':1,'adopted_original_review_calls':268,'continuation_review_calls':3020,'repeated_review_calls':0")
s=s.replace("'external':148,'projection_margin':.5", "'external':148,'projection_margin':.5,'continuation_local':58,'remaining_local_artifact_bound':.25")
s=s.replace('Candidate adds16 phase-coupling coordinates', 'Original disk-guard review failure preserved;268 complete calls adopted after full source/input/parent/output/export checks,3020 missing calls continued once,no completed call repeated. All13 scientific owners terminal. Candidate adds16 phase-coupling coordinates')

s=(repo/'.cache/verify-v163-publication-v1.py').read_text()
s=s.replace('v163-harmonic-phase-final-v1.json','v163-harmonic-phase-final-v2.json').replace('v163-harmonic-phase-publication-verification-v1.json','v163-harmonic-phase-publication-verification-v2.json')
s=s.replace("guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))", "guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'));guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json'))")
s=s.replace("assert execution['recorded_owner_count']==11", "assert execution['recorded_owner_count']==13\nassert execution['scientific_stage_failures']==1 and execution['explicit_review_continuations']==1 and execution['repeated_review_calls']==0\nadoption=read(root/'review-adoption-v2.json');assert adoption['adopted_head_calls']==268\nassert review['adopted_prior_returned_forwards']==268 and review['continuation_new_component_forwards']==3020\nfirst=read(review['collections']['anchor-control-raw-step1000']['path'])\nfor key in ['forward_journal','observation_journal']:\n    prior_key='original_'+key\n    assert ref(adoption[prior_key]['path'])==adoption[prior_key]\n    assert Path(first[key]['path']).read_bytes().startswith(Path(adoption[prior_key]['path']).read_bytes())")
s=s.replace("'paired_current_error_entries':paired_entries,", "'verified_adopted_original_review_calls':268,'new_continuation_review_calls':3020,'scientific_stage_failures':1,'repeated_review_calls':0,'paired_current_error_entries':paired_entries,")
write('verify-v163-publication-v2.py',s)
s=(repo/'.cache/build-v163-final-report-v1.py').read_text()
s=s.replace('v163-harmonic-phase-final-v1.json','v163-harmonic-phase-final-v2.json').replace('v163-harmonic-phase-publication-verification-v1.json','v163-harmonic-phase-publication-verification-v2.json')
s=s.replace("execution['recorded_owner_count']==11","execution['recorded_owner_count']==13")
s=s.replace('All eleven original scientific owners are terminal, with no scientific failure or restart.', 'All thirteen original and continuation scientific owners are terminal. The original review stopped at a combined disk guard after 268 completed control calls; its log does not identify which disk crossed its floor. All original source/log/journal/export bytes are retained. Full input/parent/output/export checks adopted those 268 calls, then an explicit continuation evaluated only the missing 3,020 main calls. No completed call or training run was repeated; one scientific review-stage failure is recorded.')
s=s.replace('New local/external reserves are 60/148 GiB plus a 0.5 GiB projected margin;', 'Initial local/external reserves were 60/148 GiB; continuation uses 58/148 GiB with a 0.25 GiB remaining local artifact bound and a 0.5 GiB projected margin;')
s=s.replace('human-report-builder-v1.json','human-report-builder-v2.json')
write('build-v163-final-report-v2.py',s)
save(root/'final-revision-preparation-v2.json',{'status':'prepared-for-explicit-review-continuation-before-quality',
    'sources':new,'prior_frozen_helpers':ref(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json'),
    'adoption':ref(root/'review-adoption-v2.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
